finish_summary: 1) bulk_discount_percent returns 5% for quantity 50 (should be 10%). 2) parse_coupon is case‑sensitive; spec says it should accept lowercase codes. 3) shipping_fee references undefined constants (FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD, SHIPPING_BASE), causing NameError; spec expects constants defined or logic to compute fee. 4) Cart.remove_item only deletes an item when quantity becomes negative; spec requires removal when zero or less. 5) Cart.total uses the pre‑coupon subtotal to calculate shipping, but spec says shipping is based on post‑coupon amount.
